Reads hosts from Termius or another CSV, MobaXterm, PuTTY, SecureCRT or mRemoteNG files. With preview set it only returns what it found. Otherwise the hosts are imported in batches of 100 with the same rules as bulk-import. The user needs the host create and edit permissions.
